messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick heads up — integrator SSO key rotation is scheduled for Tue 10:00 PDT. Marketplace listing team needs to confirm the scan/pen acceptance callback flow before we rotate keys.

sam-security: Thanks Anna. Can you confirm acceptance criteria for pen fixes? We need: retest report (PDF), repro & fix commit SHAs, CVE list if applicable, and a signed 'proof-of-fix' JSON from the integrator.

anna-partnerships: Yep that's what partner agreed to. They also asked for an automated callback so their CI can get pass/fail via webhook. Wants HMAC-signed payloads.

jake-eng: I can add a callback endpoint on the marketplace side. Proposal: POST /integrations/pen-callback with header X-Marketplace-Signature. Payload: {"status": "pass|fail", "artifacts": [urls], "evidence": url}. We'll HMAC using rotated key. Example client curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://marketplace.internal/integrations/pen-callback \ 
  -H "X-Marketplace-Signature: sha256=..." \ 
  -d '{"status":"pass","evidence":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/marketplace/evidence/123.pdf"}'
```

jake-eng: I'll put a short TTL for keys and support replay protection (nonce + timestamp). Need partner to expose callback URL + public key for verification? Or they want shared secret?

olivia-sis: Integrator prefers asymmetric validation (they don't want to hold another long-lived symmetric secret). They'll accept a signed JWT from Redwood (kid in header) or an HTTPS callback with our cert.

sam-security: Asymmetric is preferable. Requirements from Sec: signed JWT must include iss/kid/exp and hmac of artifact list. For audit we store the raw JWT and store mapping to pen ticket ID. Also need the PDF to be S3 presigned with restricted TTL and versioned path.

maria-legal: Reminder: any callback containing PII or customer identifiers must be redacted. For launch announcements we need an embargo clause in the acceptance doc: partner confirms they won't publicize until marketplace release window opens.

anna-partnerships: Noted. We'll add an "embargoed_until" field in the proof-of-fix JSON and require partner signature. Sample proof-of-fix schema: {"pen_id":"PEN-1234","status":"pass","artifacts":["s3://..."],"retest_report":"s3://...","embargoed_until":"2025-08-14T16:00:00Z","signed_by":"Integrator Name","signature":"base64"}

sam-security: Good. Also add acceptance checklist boolean flags (retest_ok, vuln_patch_ok, e2e_tests_ok). CI callback must fail if any are false.

jake-eng: I'll implement a lightweight validation lambda: verify JWT signature -> fetch retest_report (S3) -> ensure checksum matches manifest -> publish to audit log topic. Endpoint will return 202 immediately then async validation. We'll post final status to partner callback URL they provide.

anna-partnerships: Timeline: Jake to implement endpoint by Mon EOD, partner to provide public key + callback URL by Tue 08:00, security to confirm checklist format by Tue 09:30, rotation at Tue 10:00.

sam-security: I'll prepare the JSON schema and share a quick example. Also adding automated regression step: if any high CVE recur within 30 days we auto-revoke listing.

maria-legal: I'll draft the embargo verbiage and attach to the acceptance artifact. Keep it short — 72hr notice to marketing for joint announcement.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy.preview/marketplace/feature/pen-callback-impl-42 (staging). Logs show webhook receiver up, cert chain valid. :rocket:

anna-partnerships: Great — I'll ping integrator for keys and sign-off once Jake and Sam confirm schema. Thanks all :handshake:
